character.name: Amaal
character.design: Based on user-provided reference, woman on the left.
character.production: Generated directional sprite sheet, sliced into 16 ground-aligned frames and resized for game use.

mapLayouts: Purposeful connected property fences and named gates, clear pedestrian lanes with seating and supplies in recesses, eight distinct towns, dense roadside woodland groves and rounded ground boundaries.
note: Source sprites are part of this game, not supplied as a separate asset library.

generatedArtwork.artDirection: Amaal reference-based warm fantasy pixel art, consistent proportions, shading and outlines for all NPCs.

roles: 104 globally unique residents with town-specific clothes and professions
residents.poses: 416 directional views aligned to Amaal’s game scale; subtle steps and job effects animate at runtime.

generatedArtwork.previewed: Generated sheets shown in the conversation before integration.

themedHouses.production: Generated whole isolated buildings from eight historical theme sheets, resized with pixel sampling and individually measured doorway offsets. Seven towns use twenty designs; the full twenty-four-design atlas retains the archived Rosepetal house theme.

regionalMap.design: User-selected MapA, adapted to unlabelled production artwork; town labels, hover effects and fast travel are interactive code.

atlasRepairs: Corrected incomplete source crops for houses, rocks, pine, forest trees, fern, bed, fireplace, table, crates, barrels, planters and signs.
npcAI: Original in-browser finite-state schedule planner and weighted pathfinding. No paid service, account, installation, language model or external runtime dependency.
